newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on hedge, locals, grains down.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on hedge, locals, grains down.

text.p: WCE canola ended down on hedge and local sales met by scale-down commercial, export demand.

"Exporters and commercials bought scale down from locals. Chicago was down and we had hedges too," a trader said. Jan Mar spread at $0.40, Mar-May $0.40. January futures crush margin fell to -44.04 from -43.86 Friday on January soyoil, meal. Volume was 4,075 lots, or 81,500 tonnes.
Japan bought 3,000-4,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
January canola fell $2.80 to $404.50, March lost $2.50 to $404.40. January flax fell $1.60 to $358 as crushers bought from hedgers. May-July spread at $1.50.
December feed wheat lost $2.30 to $161.70 on commercial sales, March fell $1.10 to $166. Volume was 675 lots.
February western barley lost $1.10 to $138.50, May down $0.70 to $138.10 as locals, commission houses bought from commercials. Volume was 1,250 lots.
Commercials offered feed peas, commission houses offered oats. None traded.
(All values in Canadian dollars except peas, oats).
